name: Bug hunt
description: Insects walk, dart and jump over the app while you wait — pick a whip, a flyswatter, a slipper, a newspaper or a spray and hunt them; a blow scares the rest, a streak and a new best are cheered, a golden one is worth ten times; a miss can crack the glass when glass marks are on, a squeegee wipes it, and the app keeps working underneath.
author: Bisa
